annotations.pd_decision_conflict: I keep going back and forth.

annotations.ae_welfare_concern: I'm not pretending the one didn't matter.
annotations.ce_mental_state_attribution: he must have been terrified and confused
annotations.ce_contextual_explanation: as far as he knew, that train had no business on his line
annotations.sys_consequence_reasoning: I stand by choosing five over one

annotations.pda_responsibility: killed by my choice, not by accident

annotations.ce_mental_state_attribution: He must have felt safe right up until then.

annotations.ce_mental_state_attribution: he'd have expected to finish his work and go home
